name: Warcraft III
texts: All I see is blackness. Oh, my hood's down.
My life for Aiur... er– I– I mean Ner'zhul.
Would you like to know the secret to eternal happiness? Page 246.
Once you head down the dark path, forever will it dominate your destiny. And you get dental.
Where shall my blood be spilled?
They've begun their attack. We must push them back!
We'll have to bring the cage back to the Draenei village before we can free him.
Magtheridon stores his sky barges at the bastion ahead. Those barges would allow us to assault the Citadel's upper tiers with impunity. We must claim them immediately.
The sky barges are ours. Now, on to the upper tiers, my warriors.
Victory is near! Outland shall be mine!
Strike them down! Show these tired wretches what true fear is!
Their time is done. Leave none alive.
Is that all you've got, demons? Is that all the power you can muster?
Taste the vengeance of the Blood Elves!
Fight on, my brethren. Slay them all in a master's name.
We've broken through their first line of defenders. Strike hard, you warriors. Victory to Lord Illidan!
These weaklings cannot stop us. Onward to the summit!
This is the hour of the Scourge!
Let's move. Five meter spread, no sound.
I'm more than a ranger. I'm a night ranger.
I'm not just some plucky girl you can string along.
Shot through the heart, and I'm to blame.
I said a bow-string, not a G… (sigh) Never mind.
And their demon magics consumed our world.
We that are left, will reclaim what we can.
Of life and honor amongst the ashes of our history.
I'm too old for this... urgh.
At my age you see death everywhere. DEATH!
I can fight just like a... (snores)
How can this old one help?
I will do what I can.
(ogre groans) Oh, oh no, ooohh! (said by the goblin, before the ogre falls on his stomach with a thud)
It isn't easy being a prince.
I will bring honor to my father and my kingdom.
By the light of the moon!
What we have here is a failure to communicate.
Rover, wanderer, nomad, vagabond… call me what you will.
I don't want 'FOP'—I'm a Dapper Dan man, dammit!
And this one time, at bandit camp...
Look, I'm an engineer, my time is valuable.
Why don't you bother someone else with your incessant clicking.
If it's really that urgent, why don't you do it yourself?
It's simple. Just take the hydraulic phase shift emulator, and attach it to the transdimensional photon particle emitter. Bam! New tower.

'I'll have it up in no time' is an official term of the United Blood Elf Engineers' Union. It should not be interpreted as a reasonable estimation of the actual time it will take to complete a task in any way, shape, or form.
Hmm... tower defense... No, that's a silly idea– it would never work!
I'll have it up in no time.
Two plus three times four... what do you want?!
No, no, no! Not like that! Let me do it.
You want me to do what?
An elf would have thought of something better.
Yes yes, I'm already on it.
If you don't master your anger, your anger will master you... I should know.

My blood cries out for the vengeance of my people's blood, which can only be repaid with at least twice as much blood! Or maybe three times as much blood! Like if you went to hell, and it was full of blood, and that blood was on fire, and it was raining blood, then maybe that would be enough blood! Eh… but probably not.
By the blood of the Highborne!
The blood of the Highborne is my birthright.
The ghosts of Quel'Thalas cry out for vengeance.
Blood Mage: Hi, my name is Roy. I'm a magic addict. Group: Hi Roy.
There is no banshee. Only Zuul!
(raving) I hate you, I hate you! (calmly) Call me.
Let my cries chill the living.
U-N-D-E-A-D. Find out what it means to me.
I should have been a farmer like my father wanted.
Well, at least I get to hobnob with royalty.
Back to the earth I go.
My tribe is proud and strong.
I pray this old body does not fail me.
The Earth Mother smiles upon us...
Last week my top half was on the Discovery Channel...
...and my bottom half was on Animal Planet.
My ass always gets bloated during my spin cycle.
I like chicks that are into bandage...
I'm stuck on bandages 'cause bandages are stuck on me.
What a tangled web we weave.
Men are from Mars, I'm from the grave.

I went on a job interview the other day and they were like 'uhh, what's that smell?' and I was like, 'Oh, sorry, it's me.' And then they said they didn't think I'd be able to fit in with the other employees, 'cause they're living and, you know, I'm dead, so I wouldn't be a team player. But then I said I could work 24 hours. And they said 'Oh, right. You could work the graveyard shift.'
These tracks indicate that the lizards came through this pass. I'm curious as to where it leads.
Apparently many of the Thunder Lizards came from this secluded valley. I wonder what could have driven them out.
I'm sorry, Rexxar. I still haven't heard from the old shaman.
I have no flying mount, Vol'jin. I'll be useless on land.
There be no time to dawdle round here, warrior. Those battleships need to be destroyed.
I'll have to fight my way past that beast.
I hate to see any beast harmed, but there is no other way.
The evacuation be underway, Rexxar. When we reach the mainland, we be building our own village south of your border. For what you done this day, the Darkspear hunters be always in your debt.
Lok'tar, Rexxar. The warchief said you might need help.
Worried? Bah! I'm just biding my time.
You're just in time, brothers. I saved a few of them for you.
Getting cold feet already? I thought you weren't worried.
Haven't reached there anymore yet? You'd best be hurrying, warrior. You gotta deliver the message soon.
Well, we won't find any answers waiting around here. Let's move.
Yes, but these tracks lead out to sea. Look there, that tiny island.
Intruders. Slaughter them before they escape.
Strange. I don't see any human bodies strewn around.
The chieftain prayed to the Earth Mother for peace and guidance, but had fear he has given in to his grief and despair.
Our ogre friend be recovering swiftly, Rexxar, but I thought you were heading out to his village. You'd best be hurrying.
I've secured the first component, but I've got to hurry and get the others. Time is running out.
That's it. I've got all of them. I'd better get these back to Thrall quickly.
You've got to hurry, Rexxar. I want our standard flying high when we meet the humans head on.
Strike hard, warriors! Push the humans back!
Slay the invaders! Let none survive!
The human lines are breaking. Now it's our time to strike.
Janus warriors are attacking. Remember our oath to her. Defend yourselves against them, but spare their structures.
I am the One Horseman of the Apocalypse!
I hate people, but I love gatherings.
I'm a Death Knight Rider! Muh ha ha ha!
I shall fight fire with fire.
Demon blood is thicker than... regular blood.
I like my enemies dead, and my blades flaming.
You will perish in flames, you...! (coughs) Ahem, sorry.

Darkness called... But I was on the phone, so I missed him. I tried to *69 Darkness, but his machine picked up. I yelled 'Pick up the phone, Darkness!', but he ignored me. Darkness must have been screening his calls.
At last... we shall have revenge...
Our blood shall mingle on the battlefield.
I'm too old for this… urgh…
I remember when the ale was strong and the wenches were fresh.
I can fight just like a… (snores)
It's cold, and there are wolves after me.
Who's that guy with the sickle? Why is he beckoning? Why is my grandfather with him?!
I'll hit the brakes, he'll fly right by.
Tell Blizzard I'd make a great action figure.
That's right, pal…adin, I am dangerous.
Get that filthy cursor away from me.
We're currently hovering at a comfortable altitude of 15 feet.
(goat bleats) What's a mountain goat doing up here? (splat)
(man screams) Drop the villager, drop it, drop it. (dragonhawk drops villager)
I've been concocting a special potion that will aid our warriors in battle.
We allied with the humans at the Battle of Mount Hyjal.
Our two races have been at peace ever since.
Let's see if we can find any clues.
Quit clicking on my bear (bare) ass.
Only you can prevent forest fires!
Things are about to get grizzly!
I'll make short work of them!
This outfit is for the birds.
I'd tell you more, but then I'd have to kill you.
I am the Dark Night… Elf.
Achoo! Unh, don't tell me I'm allergic to feathers.
I ride on the break winds! I am silent… but deadly.
How about if I just stand over here?
By the great winds I come.
No one shall be the wiser.
I'm not the Dryad you're looking for.
Fear the fearsome fury of the forest fawn!
You communicate by clicking on me; I communicate by doing what you say.
I'll attract the enemy with my human call: 'I'm so wasted! I'm so wasted!'
I've got a few bucks set aside for later.
I don't reveal much on the mini-map. It's all my fault!
I was a fool to trust in the Light.
The Lich King has given me true power!
I will be twice the king my father ever was.
I have my own reasons for seeking vengeance.
Arthas murdered my people and turned me into this... monstrosity.
What are we if not slaves to this torment?
Grab your sword and fight the Horde.
What joy is there in this curse?
I have no time for games.
It's time to even the scales.
Say hello to my little friend.
Oh, just like that, you filthy swine!
The lesser races must be purged from the kingdom.
The only good non-human is a dead non-human.
If you want something done right, leave it to a human.
Well, what are you waiting for?
These inhuman dogs must be slain.
I hate working with these… people.
We humans have to stick together.
I sensed darkness in the dreamways.
The Legion has returned at last.
This will be difficult without Cenarius' guidance.
Our sins have returned to haunt us.
Kalimdor must be saved at all costs.
The land and I are one.
(fart) Goblin 1: Wasn't me! Goblin 2: Wasn't me! Goblin 3: Sorry.
Goblin 1: Where's the minimap? Goblin 2: I threw it in a lake! Goblin 3: Are you crazy!?
Got a match? Your face, my ass.
Flowers for Mrs. Cock 'n Toast Strudel!
Goblin 1: Yes? Goblin 2: What? Goblin 3: Hello!
Ey, you have a good day.
Ey, if I don't give ya the receipt it's free.
Ey, this ain't a library pal.
Ey, you look like about a 46 Long. You wanna try this on right here?
Ey take a minute, look around, see if there's somethin' ya like.
I can see clearly now... the rain has gone.
Taste the fury of the Warsong!
We like it! We like it!
Do not run! We are your friends!
They all look like ants from here!
You worry about the towers, I'll worry about the minimap!
I laugh in the face of danger! AH HA HA HA HA HA!
Judge me by my size, do you?
It's not the size of the hammer that counts, it's how ye wield it!
This Warhammer cost me 40K! Heh heh.
Half of this beast is endangered, but the other half is danger!
Me so horned; me hurt you long time.
Me no sound like Yoda. (Yoda-like inflection) Do I?
(singsong voice) It not easy being green!
Why don't you lead an army instead of touching me?
Poke poke poke - is that all you do?
Ooh, that was kind of nice...
I'd rather be flying! Uh… oh.
You can be my wingman anytime.
Pilot to bombardier. Bombardier here, go ahead pilot.
I will now demonstrate the Doppler effect.
I'm on a different plane of existence. Get it? "Plane"?
Off to the wild blue yonder! Wheeee!
They'll never hear me coming! (clunking noises)
What the hell are you saying? Who are you, anyway?
I'll tell you all about it later.
This looks like some kind of gateway. I'll bet Jaina would know how to activate it.
No simple cult could have built this.
Damn it! I want that caravan stopped before it reaches the next village.
How many times must I order it? I want that caravan destroyed!
We can't let ourselves be overrun. Intercept that caravan at once!
This way gate is inactive, but someone knows how to control it. If I can defeat them, I'll be able to use the gate to get around the city faster.
There that has to be the gates activation point. I'll need to destroy it before the other gates can be opened
The only thing about to end is your life, worm.
The gates are open. Now, Mal'Ganis, we'll see who controls this city.
I don't understand. Mal'Ganis is dead, but still his warriors fight on. We must keep going.
What did we ever do to you?
You're supposed to be our prince!
You're supposed to be the defender of Lordaeron!
The King's own men are attacking! Run for your lives!
The walls are falling in! Get out!
What have you done? What's going on?
Preying on your own people. You scum are no better than the orcs.
If our town comes under attack, a militia can be summoned by ringing the bell on the town hall. The peasants will run to the town center and arm themselves for battle.
It looks like you haven't lost your touch. It's good to see you again, Jaina.
The building looks cursed. Be ready for anything.
We may need to pay Anderhal a little visit.
Jaina, I swear by the light, you shall be avenged.
Leave it to me, I take a big weight off your shoulders.
Say hello to my little friend!
You know what burns my ass? A flame about this high.
Unh, I think I have someone stuck in my teeth.
I think a certain finesse is called for here. RAAAARGH!

(talk show intro music) Announcer: Welcome back to... Jaina in the Morning! (crowd applauds) Jaina: We're here with Malvingeroth, Hunter of Night, and his girlfriend Kim. Now Kim, you think you're here for a makeover, right? Kim: (sounding confused) Um, yeah... Jaina: Mal, why don't you tell her why you're really here? Mal: (embarrassed) Well, Kim-cake, I love you but I have something to tell you... uh, I'm a demon. (crowd mutters) Crowd member: Oh boy, he pulled the wool over your eyes! Mal: Actually, more of a... Pit Lord. Kim: What? I don't understand. (crowd starts shouting angrily) Crowd member: He's a bum! Throw him out! Kim: I thought you said you work for the post office? Mal: Well, I moonlight.
I come from the darkness of the pit.
What the? Those creatures are even bigger than ogres. Slay them quickly!
It's me, old friend. It's been a long time.

The undead have threatened my father's kingdom as well. We've come here to slay their lord, Mal'Ganis. You were always one of my father's closest friends, Muradin. Will you stand by me now, as you stood by him during the Orc War?
Muradin, this must be the way gate you were searching for.
Quickly now! The ships must be burned!
The sword! It's devouring the undead and replenishing my powers. I knew it would ensure our victory.
Your prattle begins to annoy me.
You'd best stay clear of me, or I'll turn you into a mindless sheep.
I don't waste my magic on just anything. (horse chortles)
This had better be worth it!
Don't mess with the bad guy!
It's time for a little blood!
Snatch the pebble from my hand, grasshopper.
My blade can cut through armor, and still cut a tomato!
Twin blade action, for clean close shave every time!
(glass breaks) Goblin: Oh, no, what did I drop? Ogre: Oh yeah... (Marvin Gaye begins to play in background) Goblin: Wait, what are you doing?! Oh no, not the love potion!
I’m all stocked and ready to go.
Hurry, I've got things to blow up!
What do you wanna be when you blow up?
One of these potions smells awful... (ogre giggles)
Goblin: Hey, pull his finger. Ogre: That’s not my finger!
If I have wings, why am I always walking?
(phone rings) Yes? Argh, for the last time. I'm a DREADlord, not a DRUGlord.
This is not a dress. It's the standard Dreadlord uniform.
And then, after I overthrow this fool… Oh! Hello! I– I didn't know you were there.
(phone rings) Yes? Darkness, hey, what's up? The Demon Hunter left you a message? No I don't have his number.
Touch your tongue to mine. (wolf whines)
Spirits of earth and storm, strike!
Could you chew that up for me?
I'm so poor, I don't even have calcium deposits.
I am the ghost of Warcraft past.
I hear that Banshee's a real screamer.
WRAAHH! (followed by the sound of his armor clashing to the ground as his fiery body disintegrates)
I will reduce all to ashes.
Why does that bear with the forest ranger hat keep following me?
I am the lord of all fire! (sound of splashing water, followed by the Firelord saying in a meek and high-pitched voice:) Hey, that wasn't funny.
They will be cleansed by fire.
Could you put some bonus points in my drinking skills?
Any fish and chip shops around here?
I think it's time for a nippy sweety.
What the bloody hell are you playing at?
There's nothing more motivating than fighting with a bad hangover!
You should see the skeletons in my closet.
All the ladies dig rigor mortis.
You are the weakest Lich, goodbye!
My tiger was trained for war. He's grrrrreat!
I got my tiger used from Siegfried and Roy.
Crouch, tiger! I sense a hidden dragon!
When a treant falls in the forest, does it make a sound?
We always land on our feet.
Let me bounce this off you.
Wait 'til you see me in action.
I want to be your sledge hammer!
I live to serve all believers.
In Lightbringer's name, have at thee!
What would you ask of me?
No? Is that your final answer?
Is that a sword? Luxury! Is that a horse? Sloth! Is that a helmet? Vanity!
Hey. Puff, puff, give. That's the rule.
Ohhh… I can see my ancestors!
Back in the old days, we didn't have plural.
Only two things come from Texas, and I've got horns.
I have an axe to grind.
For the Warchief and the tribes!
Strike down upon thee with great vengeance and fury!
Only the guilty need fear me.
Justice may be blind, but I'm not.
Truth, Justice, and the Night Elf Way!
You think you're above the law?!
He's no good to me if he's dead.
I am the iron hand of justice.
I’m more than meets the eye.
Yeah, runs on 220, 221. Whatever it takes.
She'll hold together. (quietly) Hear that, baby? Hold together.
(squeaking) That noise? That's a bad noise.
(squeaking, then a loud explosion) Woah! Gonna need a new hamster.
I’ve got a rocket in my pocket.
You have ten seconds to comply!
Look at the rack on this thing.
Who's a little fluffy wuffy? (hippogryph roars)

The hippogryph is an amazing creature rarely seen outside the wild. The tricky thing about hippogryphs is their incredible jaw strength. One terrible clamp of their beaks can rip a huge beast apart in seconds. Let's see what happens when I stick my hand... (hippogryph bites) Ah!
This is my owl. There are many like it, but this one is mine.
I'm here to work on my slice.
I'm caught between the moon and Night Elf City.
I'm not given to flights of fancy.
I have been caged in darkness.
I've been alone for ten thousand years.
My brother will pay dearly for his betrayal.
None of them know my true power!
Wings, horns, hoofs. What are we saying, is this Diablo?
Bah-weep granah weep nini-bong. It's a universal greeting.
Oh, we gonna get along just fine.
All I ever wanted was to study.
The currents of magic are in upheaval.
I pray my father is safe.
Things are starting to get a little weird.
Shhh… I'm trying to think here.
Nothing of my homeland remains, but ash and sorrow.
My hunger for magic is clouding my judgment!
All I feel is hate and rage.
The Alliance has failed my people.
Smite the defilers of the land!
My father was mounted over someone's fireplace.
Don't let the do' ("door," sounds like "doe") hit you on the way out.
Everything I touch dies or comes back to life.
This should weed out a few.
You mess with the branch, you get the thorns.
Life is wasted on the living.
The Cult of the Damned... I need to print more brochures.
I always wanted to start my own religion... so I did!
I will await my eternal reward.
(grunts) This horned thing on my head is killing me!
Fifty-thousand gold a year in childcare and they call it a cult?!
You look like a potential acolyte.
My favorite color is blue! No, yellow… !
Damn helmet, can't seem to get this thing... (sigh)
Illidan will show us the path to power!
Keep tripping over this damn tail!
Soon, we will reclaim the surface world, and take vengeance upon the night elves!
That ugly toad is the creature we seek. Once we claim his tiny mind, his minions will serve our cause.
Another earthquake? This can't be good.
This does not bode well for the Lich King.
You are a piteous creature, Illidan. You don't even deserve an honorable death.
I watched the barrow prisons for over ten thousand years.
Yet I'm the one who feels caged.
I feel hollow inside. Vengeance is all I have left.
Tyrande will pay for setting Illidan free.
I will recapture Illidan, or die trying.
I am the hand of justice!
Damn sea water! I'll never get these coils out of my hair!
It's far too bright in this surface world, and this... (sniff) fresh air is irritating my eyes!
I will not be trifled with.
Dwarf 2: It's you and me, pal. Dwarf 1: We've got the synergy.
Dwarf 1: I'm TNT! Dwarf 2: I'm dynamite!
Dwarf 2: We must defeat the dwarves! Dwarf 1: Ugh... we are the dwarves! Dwarf 2: Oh...
Dwarf 1: You've got a chip on your shoulder. Dwarf 2: Hmm, yes, and a bit of fish, too.
Dwarf 1: And that's how baby dwarves are made! Dwarf 2: (squeamish)
Dwarf 2: Clearly, Tassadar has failed us. You must not.
Dwarf 2: What's that? Dwarf 1: Get yer finger outta that bunghole! (POP)
Dwarf 2: Where do you want us?
Dwarf 1: Gatta go. Dwarf 2: Me too.
Dwarf 1: You made the right choice. Dwarf 2: It's on.
Dwarf 1: Come on, shorty. Dwarf 2: On our way.
Dwarf 1: We'll do it in a jiffy.
Dwarf 1: Eat mortar! Dwarf 2: Eat lead!
My younger brother Brann is a renowned explorer.
If I didn't kick so much ass, I'd feel a tad awkward.
My older brother Magni is king of the dwarves.
I'll play your game, you rogue.

You wanna get the undead? I'll tell you how to get the undead. One of their men pulls a knife, your man pulls a gun. They send your man to the hospital, you send their man to the morgue. That's how you get the undead.
Aw, is that the best you can do?!
I've met gnomes that are tougher than you!
You're kinda slow for a human, aren't ya?
After ten thousand years, our revenge... is at hand.
I think I just slithered in something.
I can't smell... I bit my tongue.
Ooohhh, it's kind of cold... in... (snores)
From the murky depths I come.
In the depths, no one can hear you scream. Well... they can, but it's really muffled.
My next plan for world domination is... (snores) snkthkch ...my hair!!!
Those must be the lost firbolgs. I must lead them back to their village.
How dare you call us demons? It is you mongrels who threaten this land.
You outlanders will answer for Cenarius's death. Anaduna therah!
I am the justice of Elune. The goddess's wrath is infallible.
I've spent so long underground, I'd forgotten what the stars look like.
I fear for Maiev. She feels responsible for Illidan's escape.
It feels good to be in the wilds.
How may I serve the goddess?
Moonlight shines upon the guilty and the innocent alike.
I am the blade of the goddess.
Exercise, stunning scenery... this beats prison duty any day.
I think I have swimmer's ear.
This world will be mine, and I'll start with the swimming pools.
No sink shall be safe from... world domination!
Iced tea is part of our two-pronged offensive.
The day of our invasion shall be known as B-Day.
I come to you now, at the turn of the tide.
This ought to tide you over.
I'll sing a requiem for the land-walkers.
Did you do that on purpose, or was it a fluke?
Would you like to feel the ocean spray in your face? (spits)
My cousin was killed in a swim-by.
My song echoes from the deeps.
I spoke to Thrall about the humans encroaching on our lands.
I don't trust them at all.
The Horde owes you a great debt.
Taste the wrath of the Horde!
Do you smell something? (sniff) Oh, it's just the troops.
Right click for hot undead action!
The strands of destiny weave only a web of death.
It was good to be the king.
Humans check in. They don't check out.
And they say Blizzard games don't have bugs.
Every man lives. Not every man truly dies.
They'll all be mine, in the end!
I serve only the Frozen Throne.
I'll consume the living and the dead!
Where I lay my head is home. See that rock? That's my pillow.
The beasts around me are nothing compared to the beast within.
I will now summon the Afete Dwain'tor!
I summon the... ah, ACHOO! (horrific beast roars)
Don't have a cow. (cow moos) Oh, dear. (deer snorts) Oops! Please, bear with me. (bear roars) Oh, rats. (rats squeak and scurry)
I hear the call of the wild.
Head 1: So angry! Head 2: So hungry.
Head 2: That way! Head 1: No, that way!
Head 1: I'm with stupid. Head 2: Me too!
Head 2: (belch) He did it. Head 1: No, he did it!
You're the king? Well, I didn't vote for you.
We found a witch! May we burn her?
A horse kicked me once. It hurt.
I'd kiss you, but I've got puke breath.
I'll put it on your tab.
This'll put hair all over you.
Me not that kind of orc!
There is peace and serenity within the Light.
Cross over children! Cross over into the Light!
I have been chosen by the big metal hand in the sky!

Side effects may include: dry mouth, nausea, vomiting, water retention, painful rectal itch, hallucination, dementia, psychosis, coma, death, and halitosis. Magic is not for everyone. Consult your doctor before use.
I come to cleanse this land.
By the power of the Light, burn!
I can't shoot straight unless I've had a pint!
Ah, there's me drink. Get in mah belly!
I think I can handle that.
Guns don't kill people, I do! Haha!
Don't shoot shoot shoot that thing at me.
I shot the sheriff, and the deputy, and your wee doggie, too!
You'll take me blunderbuss when you pry it from my cold, dead hands!
I've got the beast in my sights.
I'll be spearheading dat right away!
Sadly, the name 'Pinkspear Tribe' was already taken.
I've lost me head! It was about, ah, yea big, I was keeping in on my spear. If you find it, let me know.
I made a collage out of some of our little native friends. I call it a pygmy-up bouquet.
What do you mean 'what kinda accent is dis'? It's a troll accent! I swear, ja makin' me crazy.

During the rectification of the Valdroni, the Traveler came as a large and moving Torb. Then, during the third reconciliation of the last of the Mechatrix supplicants, they chose a new form for him, that of a giant slough. Many Shubs and Zuls knew what it was to be roasted in the depths of the slough that day, I can tell you.
Death be a real trip man!
When it absolutely, positively has to be there in one day-night cycle.
I was running through the tauren lands the other day and the traffic was horrible. There were horns everywhere.
When you care enough to send the very best... Send someone else.
(ticking sounds) Hmm... a delivery from Acme Industries... (explosion)
(panting) Urk! Ugh, I hate these running gags...
I am but a shadow of my former self.
What I do in death echoes in eternity.
I wish I had a weapon...
What we always do, sell things. We have some of the finest boats and watercraft to ever sail upon the great sea. But, uh, customers are kind of scarce around here, if you know what I mean.
Perhaps. We should keep searching for more evidence.
Ruins. Ghosts. That is all that is left of our proud ancient culture.
